steps.name: AWPIS: Initialize Pipeline Run
steps.description: Loads client config, generates run ID, clears state, and writes the initial RUNNING row to the Runs tab.

inputParameters.name: client_id
inputParameters.description: The client ID from the Config tab (e.g. motoverse)

outputParameters.name: run_id
outputParameters.description: Unique run identifier for this pipeline execution

outputParameters.name: client_id
outputParameters.description: The client ID passed through for downstream steps

steps.name: AWPIS: Collect Intelligence
steps.description: Gathers PSI metrics, GitHub codebase data, run history, and security scan results into an IntelligenceBundle.

outputParameters.name: intelligence_bundle
outputParameters.description: JSON string — the full IntelligenceBundle to pass to the Performance Strategist Gem

steps.name: AWPIS: Fetch Target Code
steps.description: Receives the FixPlan from the Strategist Gem, fetches targeted source files from GitHub, and attaches SonarQube issues.

inputParameters.name: fix_plan
inputParameters.description: JSON string — the FixPlan output from the AWPIS Performance Strategist Gem

outputParameters.name: code_context
outputParameters.description: JSON string — fix plan + source file contents + SonarQube issues for the Engineer Gem

steps.name: AWPIS: Run Quality Gates
steps.description: Receives the generated fix from the Engineer Gem and runs all 4 quality gates: structural safety, SonarQube, code critic, and blast radius.

inputParameters.name: generated_fix
inputParameters.description: JSON string — the generated code fix from the Frontend/Backend Engineer Gem

outputParameters.name: gate_results
outputParameters.description: JSON string — pass/fail results for all 4 quality gates

outputParameters.name: all_gates_passed
outputParameters.description: TRUE if all gates passed, FALSE otherwise

steps.name: AWPIS: Run Sandbox Validation
steps.description: Triggers a Vercel preview deployment, runs PSI on the preview URL, checks backend health, and evaluates against baseline.

outputParameters.name: sandbox_result
outputParameters.description: JSON string — sandbox validation results including preview PSI scores

outputParameters.name: sandbox_passed
outputParameters.description: TRUE if sandbox validation passed, FALSE otherwise

steps.name: AWPIS: Deploy to Production
steps.description: Opens a GitHub PR, merges it (AUTOMATED mode), triggers Vercel production deploy, waits, runs post-deploy PSI, and checks for regressions.

outputParameters.name: deploy_result
outputParameters.description: JSON string — deployment results including PR URL, regression status, and production PSI scores

steps.name: AWPIS: Update Memory & Baseline
steps.description: Writes fix memory, updates baseline scores if improved, finalizes the Runs tab, builds the PipelineResult, and emails the report.

outputParameters.name: pipeline_result
outputParameters.description: JSON string — the complete PipelineResult for the Report Writer Gem
